freeze_meaning: Freeze identifies and preserves historical, normative, operational, and research-input baselines by exact version policy; it does not declare every statement inside them correct.
A source may be authoritative for terminology or provenance while licensing no theorem, empirical claim, product claim, or disclosure.
Byte-different artifacts remain separately recorded unless a reproducible transformation receipt proves their relation.
Mutable current-status authorities are named but not frozen by hash; they must be re-read and corroborated at claim time.
This candidate has not been accepted as the final Gate 0 freeze.

claim_firewalls: Formal definitions and theorem statements do not establish empirical readability, cognitive correspondence, alignment efficacy, or product readiness.
Engineering designs and CAS-Ohm quantities do not become instrumented measurements without units, instrument identity, calibration, provenance, and packet eligibility.
Ten Advances results and CAS/TKS transfers remain quarantined individually; manuscript presence does not establish proof, novelty, publication, or peer review.
A structural verifier PASS proves only the checks performed by that verifier.
No source or candidate status changes a product claim from OPEN or NOT LICENSED to LICENSED.
